title: Meet Brazil

body.heading: Where in the world is Brazil?
paragraphs: Brazil is a country in South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Brazil is Brasília.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Brazil is Portuguese.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Brazil is the Brazilian real.

body.heading: How big is Brazil?
paragraphs: Brazil covers about 8,516,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. It is the largest country in South America. That makes it about three times the size of Argentina.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: The Amazon rainforest stretches across northern Brazil and several neighboring countries. The Amazon is the largest rainforest in the world, home to about one in every ten species known on Earth.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Rio curves between mountains and sea: ride the train up Corcovado to Christ the Redeemer, cable cars to Sugarloaf, then land on Copacabana beach.
At Manaus the black Rio Negro meets the pale Amazon at the Meeting of Waters. Jungle lodges lead families to pink dolphins and giant water lilies.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Brazil on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Brazil in one breath: a country in South America, capital Brasília, where people speak Portuguese and pay with the Brazilian real.
materials: A globe, atlas or world map (to find Brazil)
Paper and crayons or pencils for the screen-free mission
supervision: Independent reading for confident readers; the Think and talk questions about Brazil make a good family discussion afterwards.

If your family ever visits the watery places in this article, water fun in Brazil always needs a grown-up watching closely.
screenFreeExtension: Screen-free mission: find Brazil on a map or globe, say its capital out loud, then draw the place you'd most love to visit there.
